entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
.....Petition
 Through: Mr. C.M. Grover and Ms. Payal
 Budhiraja, Advocates.

versus
 Govt Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr.

.....Respondents
 Through: Mr. Hemant Mehla, App for State.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 648/2022 of PS Harsh Vihar for offence under Section 498A/406/377/509/34 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed two weeks to file status report in view of serious allegation of sexual misconduct against petitioner no.4.
Further, it is stated that respondent no.2 is not interested to continue this settlement.
4. Subject to petitioners taking steps within one week, notice through all modes be issued to the respondent no.2, returnable on 09.07.2026.
